assets.title: Week 3 garment overview board
assets.description: A clear adult-oriented garment overview board showing several common Week 3 garments for fast recognition, including a dress, jeans, hoodie, jacket, blouse, and blazer.
assets.notes: Use as the opener asset for quick garment identification. Keep the silhouettes distinct and easy to recognize.

assets.title: Tops and upper garments vocabulary board
assets.description: A vocabulary board showing T-shirt, shirt, blouse, sweater, hoodie, and cardigan as separate adult-oriented garment visuals.

assets.title: Bottoms and one-piece garments vocabulary board
assets.description: A vocabulary board showing skirt, pants, shorts, jeans, dress, and jumpsuit as clear separate visuals.
assets.notes: Keep dress and skirt visually distinct and make pants and jeans easy to compare.

assets.title: Outerwear and complete-look vocabulary board
assets.description: A vocabulary board showing jacket, coat, blazer, and one simple complete outfit or look as separate fashion-study visuals.
assets.notes: Use to support the final vocabulary matching set and category distinctions.

assets.title: Three-garment reading board
assets.description: One reading-support image board showing three clearly different garments that match the Week 3 short reading texts, such as a white shirt, blue dress, and black jeans.
assets.notes: Single board is preferred over three separate files to keep the asset set compact.

assets.title: Reusable garment card set
assets.description: A reusable set of garment image cards or gallery visuals showing jacket, skirt, shorts, blouse, dress, jeans, and coat for listening, writing support, and live speaking.
assets.notes: Use one shared asset for multiple activities instead of separate listening, writing, and speaking image sets.

assets.title: Garment description listening audio
assets.description: A short teacher-style listening clip describing common garments, their category, and one or two features for beginner learners.
assets.notes: Transcript should remain inside audio_prompts.json rather than as a separate asset.
